blocks.text: The use of large language models (LLMs) and other machine learning (ML) models has created new security blind spots. Organizations often download models from public repositories without a reliable way to inspect them for any vulnerabilities. The AI models can contain malicious code, backdoors, or embedded secrets that execute with the host application's privileges, posing a serious risk to data and systems.

AI Security AI model security provides a framework to enforce security on AI models. The AI model scanner is a command-line tool that developers and MLOps engineers can run before deploying AI models to production. You can integrate the scanner into local workflows or CI/CD pipelines to stop threats before they reach sensitive environments and ensure security across all AI model deployments.
The AI model scanner provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Threat Detection: Identify malicious code, backdoors, and vulnerabilities in AI models using YARA rules and the Zscaler ThreatLabz AV engine. This prevents compromised models from entering production.
Secret Scanning: Detect embedded credentials, API keys, and sensitive information across all supported file types to reduce the risk of data breaches and system compromise.
Code Extraction: Extract and analyze embedded code from pickle files and Lambda layers to detect hidden malicious logic.

Centralized Visibility and Reporting: Integrate scan results into the AI Security Admin Portal, providing clear reports with severity levels and remediation steps for centralized scan management, auditing, and governance.
Automated Security Integration: Enable consistent, automated security checks that can be integrated into the devops pipelines.
Prevent compromised AI models from entering production environments.
Reduce risk of data breaches and disruption by malicious AI models.
Enable consistent, automated security checks across development and deployment pipelines.
Support auditing and governance through centralized reporting.

blocks.heading: About the Model Scan Management Page

blocks.text: On the Model Scan Management Page (Administration > Model Scan Management Page), you can see the following tabs:

blocks.item: Integration Registration
On the Integration Registration tab, you can do the following:
Add an integration.
Search for specific integrations in the searchable columns.
View the list of model scan integrations. For each integration, you can view:
Integration Name: The name of the integration.
Integration ID: The unique identifier for the integration.
Modified By: The user who last modified the integration.
Configured On: The date and time the integration was last configured.
Status: The current status of the integration (Enabled or Disabled).
Sort the column data.
Modify the table and its columns.
Click the Actions icon to edit or delete an integration.
Download Model Scanner
On the Download Model Scanner tab, you can view the list of available AI model scanner binaries. For each scanner binary, you can view:
Scanner Name: The name of the scanner binary. Click on the name to download the scanner file to your local system.
Scanner Version: The version number of the scanner.
Operating System: The operating system the scanner is built for (e.g., Linux, macOS).
Architecture: The processor architecture (e.g., x64, Arm64).
Release Date: The date the scanner binary was released.
